bash: cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF' 2>&1
import hashlib, base64, zipfile, sys
w="/usr/local/lib/python3.13/ensurepip/_bundled/pip-24.3.1-py3-none-any.whl"
z=zipfile.ZipFile(w)
bad=z.testzip()
print("zip integrity:", "CORRUPT: "+str(bad) if bad else "OK")
names=z.namelist()
print("entries:", len(names))
print("has pip/__init__.py:", "pip/__init__.py" in names)
rec=z.read("pip-24.3.1.dist-info/RECORD").decode().splitlines()
print("RECORD lines:", len(rec))
mism=0
for line in rec:
    parts=line.split(",")
    if len(parts)<3 or not parts[1].startswith("sha256="): continue
    try: data=z.read(parts[0])
    except KeyError: print("MISSING in wheel:", parts[0]); mism+=1; continue
    h=base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(data).digest()).rstrip(b"=").decode()
    if h!=parts[1].split("=",1)[1]:
        print("HASH MISMATCH:", parts[0]); mism+=1
print("hash mismatches:", mism)
EOF
